lines:
sequenceDiagram
participant S as Parent Scheduler
participant D as Subagent Lifecycle
participant L as Limit Controller
participant X as Context Store
participant A as Model and Agent Runtime
participant G as Worker Core Gateway
participant B as Core Invocation Broker

S->>D: SpawnChild with parent revision, explicit selection, contract, and frozen child descriptor
D->>L: admit depth fanout deadline turns context and inherited budget
alt child admission denied
  L-->>D: LimitExceededV1
  D-->>S: typed child failure for frozen attempt policy
else child admitted
  L-->>D: inherited child budget envelope
  D->>X: SpawnChildContext from declared parent projection
  X-->>D: isolated child root revision and lineage
  D->>A: StartAgentNode with child context and allowed capability refs
  loop bounded internal child turns
    A->>G: InvocationProposalV1 with child node attempt authority and budget refs
    G->>B: propose through trusted core
    B-->>G: committed CapabilityOutcomeV1
    G-->>A: deliver outcome once
    A->>X: revise child context with structured observation
    X-->>A: new child head revision
  end
  opt nested delegation is declared by frozen graph
    D->>L: admit inherited nested depth and budget
    L-->>D: permit or explicit limit outcome
    D->>X: create another isolated child lineage only when permitted
  end
  A-->>D: ChildResultV1 plus result-contract evidence
  D->>D: validate declared schema and terminal status
  alt result contract valid
    D->>X: IntegrateChild by declared map summary evaluator or aggregate transform
    X-->>D: new parent revision with child provenance
    D-->>S: IntegrationOutcomeV1 and parent revision ID
  else contract invalid, cancelled, failed, or deadline exceeded
    D->>L: close child scope and descendants
    D-->>S: explicit child outcome for frozen retry fallback or failure policy
  end
end
Note over D,X: Child conversation and scratch state never merge wholesale into the parent
Note over D,B: Recovery uses child lineage and committed invocation IDs and never reruns acknowledged child effects

data.title: Temporary Subagent Child Context and Result Integration
